text: 1、市场早间震荡调整，三大指数低开低走。风电板块逆势走强，洛轴股份、吉鑫科技涨停。纺织服装股拉升，华茂股份2连板，华升股份涨停。机器人概念盘中活跃，宁波东力、襄阳轴承、中马传动涨停。下跌方面，房地产板块下挫，华丽家族跌停；PCB概念股走低，逸豪新材跌近10%。个股跌多涨少，沪深京三市近4400股飘绿，上午半天成交1.08万亿。午间收盘沪指跌0.93%，深成指跌1.74%，创业板跌1.84%。 2、板块概念方面，风电设备、纺织制造、教育、银行等板块领涨；贵金属、白酒、房地产、PCB等板块领跌； 3、两市共1034只个股上涨，39只个股涨停；4024只个股下
text_en: 1. The market fluctuated and adjusted in the morning, with the three major indices opening lower and moving lower. The wind power sector strengthened against the trend, with Luoyang Bearing and Jixin Technology hitting the daily limit. Textile and apparel stocks rose, with Huamao shares posting a second consecutive daily limit and Huasheng shares hitting the daily limit. Robot concept stocks were active during the session, with Ningbo Dongli, Xiangyang Bearing, and Zhongma Transmission hitting the daily limit. On the downside, the real estate sector fell, with Huali Family hitting the daily limit; PCB concept stocks declined, with Yihao New Materials falling nearly 10%. Declining stocks outnumbered advancing ones, with nearly 4,400 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets trading lower, and half-day turnover reaching 1.08 trillion yuan. At the midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.93%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 1.74%, and the ChiNext Index fell 1.84%. 2. In terms of sectors and concepts, wind power equipment, textile manufacturing, education, and banking led the gains; precious metals, baijiu, real estate, and PCB led the declines; 3. Across the two markets, a total of 1,034 stocks rose, with 39 hitting the daily limit; 4,024 stocks fell
